task: Training-internal chronological LSTM epoch selection for DI regression
selection_metric: clipped DI scene-macro MAE on the inner validation backgrounds
refit: For each fold and seed, refit from scratch on all outer-fit samples for its selected epoch count
evaluation: Use exactly the prior outer evaluation keys; compare the same seeds to the saved 6-epoch predictions
scope: One fixed-budget follow-up; no architecture, feature, seed, threshold or outer-score-based search
limitations: Prior outer-fold results have been observed during development
Fixed v2 augmentation amplitudes use all Jan-Jun backgrounds
Training-internal early stopping does not establish fully tuned LSTM performance
